original_test_intent: Verify every required PCH sensor name, description and reading consistently across in-band SDR/Sensor List, out-of-band SDR/Sensor List and BMC Web against the authoritative PCH sensor specification.
original_method: Bind the exact SUT, BMC and PCH, retain complete unfiltered in-band and protected OOB SDR/Sensor List outputs at aligned timestamps, derive the PCH set using an owner-approved TEMP_PCH/record map, capture complete Web rows, normalize fields and compare every required record to the PCH specification while preserving anomaly logs.
manual_activity: The platform owner supplies the PCH sensor topology/specification and resolves whether criteria 3–9 are omitted requirements or a numbering typo; an operator captures complete Web evidence and the owner issues the verdict.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/PCH device, stepping and firmware identities
Authoritative PCH sensor specification with required names/descriptions/types/units/readings/statuses/thresholds and applicability
Stable mapping for every required PCH sensor across IB SDR, IB Sensor List, OOB SDR, OOB Sensor List and Web row
Approved secure IB/OOB access and complete Web capture path
Sampling alignment, freshness, rounding, unavailable/stale and pagination rules
Decision on the source's missing criteria numbers 3 through 9
Expected normal platform state, retained-log policy and escalation owner
safety_requirements: Match row 2012 and never run or request the row-2201 MODS storage test
Keep collection read-only and inject credentials through approved secret handling
Retain complete inventories before TEMP_PCH filtering; never pass from grep/head-only output
Never assume the test title is a literal sensor name
Do not clear logs, change thresholds, alter BMC configuration or stimulate PCH temperature
Stop on ambiguous identity, missing/duplicate sensor, malformed/stale reading or security-policy violation
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact shared-code variant and isolate MODS/NVMe contamination
Collect complete read-only IB/OOB inventories and apply only the owner-approved PCH sensor map
Normalize and compare every required field and prepare exact Web rows/screenshots
Preserve raw logs, timestamps, exits and discrepancies
Perform no storage test, sensor write, log clear, criteria invention or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve PCH sensor population, semantics, acceptable range and IB/OOB/Web mapping
Resolve the criteria-number jump and any omitted coverage
Review each mapped sensor and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Read-only ipmitool is relevant, but `sensor get 'Sensor Check - PCH'`, OOB-only collection and `head -100` cannot prove the source. Its MODS NVMe/E1.S requested output targets row 2201 and is prohibited here.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Using approved secret-safe access, retain full `sdr elist` and `sensor list` output independently in-band and OOB, select only owner-enumerated PCH records and reconcile with complete BMC-Web evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, TEMP_PCH view, BMC Web, SPEC comparison, Config-Check and 3/0-minute values remain; automatic log clearing is withheld.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a versioned PCH physical-to-SDR/Web map, aligned full inventories and a per-record comparison of identity, semantics, reading, status, threshold and freshness.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact PCH identity, completeness, secure access and normalized comparisons while removing wrong-variant MODS evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One fabricated sensor query cannot reveal absent or duplicate PCH sensors, IB/OOB drift, Web pagination, threshold disagreement or source criteria omissions.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Readings may vary with load and caching; the owner must define time alignment, normal range, rounding and stale-data rules.

SUT/BMC/PCH identity and versioned PCH sensor specification/map

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master criteria jump from 2 to 10. DeepSeek substitutes a test-title sensor and requests MODS NVMe/E1.S output belonging to the other same-code row. PCH scope is preserved, contamination is isolated and the missing criteria are escalated.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2012 variant ae8124320a145891 of shared code Wistron-HW-00482-V002: confirm whether Criteria numbering 1, 2, 10 is only a numbering typo or whether PCH-sensor Criteria 3–9 are missing; if missing, provide exact coverage and IB/OOB/Web acceptance, while keeping row 2201 MODS NVMe/E1.S evidence strictly separate.

review_improvement: Restores complete PCH sensor reconciliation, rejects the wrong-variant MODS output and exposes the source's criteria gap without inventing missing requirements.
independent_technical_reasoning: PCH sensor validation requires both population completeness and semantic equivalence across interfaces. A title-based `sensor get` may fail or hit no stable SDR record, while truncating the inventory hides missing or duplicate records. The storage output is traceably from a separate destructive variant and would produce a false positive if accepted. Since criterion 10 follows criterion 2, only the owner can determine whether seven checkpoints were omitted.
